■Stage Direction
1 second of silence at the start
Threatening tone

Ngh...! Damn it, I'm gonna break that smug nose of yours...!
Hey you bastards, settle this on that track over there!!
Time to settle the score. Just like we promised—
...Huh? You bastards were the ones being disrespectful, weren't ya?
Huh, b-boosters...?

Guh...! A free racer never goes back on her word...
Whether it's a triple scoop or a five-scooper, I'll pay for it... dammit!!

She has exceptional speed aptitude. So if we train her relentlessly
on the uphill slopes to sharpen her burst acceleration and get her totally ripped—!

Wha—?!
I thought I blew right past her, but she's already... back?!

Well, I don't mind playing along as long as it kills time.
But listen up... you've got some making up to do first, don'tcha?

Sweet♪
Then can I get a 5-scoop cone with toppings?!

—I have a dream. A dream I've held since childhood.
To become a Trainer who raises the "strongest" Umamusume.
Huh? Are you stupid or what?

Quit your damn barking.
If you can't even apologize properly... I'll just crush you.
Pay me back for my triple scoop ice cream!

Whenever I get absorbed in thought, I blurt out things that don't sound mature at all...
I know it only ends up putting people off, but it's a hard habit to break.
—Had enough, or do you still wanna play?

—A vivid display. A fierce, breathtaking run that instantly captivates anyone watching.
It looked just like the running I witnessed that day...
...Um. Excuse me... Do you have any advice regarding my run just now?

You do your best on the Trainer exam too. If we can both lead our assigned Umamusume
to win the Derby together someday, that would be amazing.
......I did it again.

To think the cause of the quarrel was just a triple scoop ice cream cone...
While I stood there dumbfounded, they walked away.

What's this? You're pretty good at taking things in stride!
The ice cream shop over there is insanely good, you should grab some too!

Suddenly coming back to my senses, I remembered we were in the middle of a confrontation. The earlier rush of excitement
turned into mounting anxiety, and I held my breath as I watched the explosive standoff.
Damn it... This wasn't supposed to happen...!!
WOOOOOOOOOOOOORAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!

She's strong, isn't she? She has the potential to stand at the top of her generation.
She could definitely take the Derby...! I need to give her my full support too.
—Haha! Not even close to done yet...!!

Ah... right... Well, thank you very much.
See ya. —Instructooor!
You pickin' a fight with me?! Huh?!

High potential. The caliber fit for the "strongest." Expectation and exhilaration.
All of it overlapped with the Fuji Kiseki I saw that day—

I want to fulfill my brother's unfulfilled dream. I want to share that dream with him once more.
That's why I will guide my assigned Umamusume to become the "strongest"—to conquer the Derby.

I have an older brother whom I deeply respect. As the physician in charge of the Umamusume named Fuji Kiseki,
he passionately supported her maintenance, conditioning, and physical care.

Sprinting through brilliantly in 1:34.7!
Fuji Kiseki takes center stage for next year's Classics!

Due to injury, Fuji Kiseki was forced to retire from the front lines.
Because he poured so much into her racing career, my brother's regrets ran deep—

It looks like a dispute between Umamusume.
They seem intent on settling it with a race, but will they really—

What's your deal, you retired "former" gang leader acting all high and mighty!
You're the one daydreaming in the middle of the road and crashing into people, ain't ya?!

Sounds great, the "strongest."
I kinda like that sort of thing.
—The next day.

With that determination, I entered Tracen Academy... but things haven't been going well.
Every time I get fired up about my dream, people get weirded out, and I still haven't found a trainee.

Here I go, here I go, here I GOOOOO!!
I'm gonna blow right past youuuuuu—!!

...T-This is the "Furious Roaring Demon"...
The former leader of "L/Roars"...!
However—
On the inside! On the inside, Fuji Kiseki! Coming up from the innermost rail, Fuji Kiseki!

......It's my fault. I failed to prevent her injury.
I was the one who shut the door on Fuji Kiseki's future...!

Compared to Fuji Kiseki, her style is much wilder and unrefined.
And yet...

Fuji Kiseki dives inside! Fuji Kiseki attacks the inside!
A yellow silk is flying in from the outside! Fuji Kiseki is in the lead!

At the Academy, I was helping the instructors with training sessions.
I volunteered to assist in order to gain coaching experience, but—

I quickly pulled my wandering thoughts back to the Umamusume in front of me.
Right now, I have to give this student my full attention!
Ora ora ora oraaa!!

—I couldn't get the run from that girl with the triple scoop ice cream out of my head.
The thrill from yesterday hadn't faded one bit. She truly has the caliber to aim for the "strongest"...!
